FQHECylinderConfiningPotentialCoefficients, version 0.01

Usage: FQHECylinderConfiningPotentialCoefficients [options]

system options:

    --confining-rightpower : integer exponent of the right confining potential (default value = 1)

    --confining-momentum : if set, the confining potential is defined in the momentum space
    --confining-phase : add an additional phase information
    --confining-leftphase : additional phase for the confining left potential in pi units (default value = 0)
    --confining-rightphase : additional phase for the confining right potential in pi units (default value = 0)
    --flux-insertion : include a flux insertion (in flux quantum unit) along the cylinder axis (default value = 0)
    --y-extension : if not zero, the confining potential is non zero along the perimeter only in the region [-L/2,L/2] (default value = 0)
